items.summary: 做跨境物流 SaaS 的，去年 10 月进尼日利亚，拉各斯、阿布贾、卡诺三个城市做尾程派送信息展示，团队 12 人，月投放预算约 8000 美元。现在的问题是素材接受度差异很大：拉各斯用「当日达」「骑手实时轨迹」这类卖点，落地页转化率 4.1%；同样的素材换到卡诺，转化只有 1.2%，用户更多问「能不能送到我这片区」「多久能到」。我们已经试过把三个城市的素材统一成「覆盖全城」的大而全版本，结果拉各斯转化掉到 2.6%，卡诺也没起来。也试过按语言分版（英语 + 豪萨语），但豪萨语版本点击率高了、注册后的实际下单率反而更低。卡在到底该按城市分素材，还是按「配送时效承诺」分素材，以及卡诺这种低转化城

items.summary: GPS tracking reveals fast east-west flights lead to a mismatch between birds' internal time and the sun’s position, skewing their sense of direction.
items.zh: 海鸟也会时差——这会让它们有点偏离航线

items.title: Some of the world’s biggest bats are getting smaller
items.summary: Madagascan flying foxes aren’t as mighty as they were 150 years ago. The big bats have shrunk, possibly due to selective hunting or other human impacts.
items.zh: 世界上一些最大的蝙蝠正在变小

items.title: How Do You Take a Picture of a Black Hole?
items.summary: Astrophysicist Shep Doeleman explains how capturing the first image of a black hole required a telescope the size of the world, and why the next goal is to create a movie. The post How Do You Take a Picture of a Black Hole? first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 如何拍摄黑洞照片？

items.title: Magnetic sensors track muscle movement, for better prosthetic limb control
items.summary: Researchers hope to use these sensors to help people with amputation achieve more natural movements with their prosthetic limbs.
items.zh: 磁传感器跟踪肌肉运动，以实现更好的假肢控制

items.title: New system gives users more control over their online experience
items.summary: The Social.Wiki framework enables anyone to easily edit social websites within the system, while allowing them to choose the content they see.
items.zh: 新系统让用户可以更好地控制自己的在线体验

items.title: ULA's Vulcan rocket is set to return to flight on Friday the 13th
items.summary: This Vulcan launch will be first to use a full complement of 6 solid rocket boosters.
